query: INSERT INTO recovery_sessions (recovery_id, account_id, rgen, started, release_at, state, source, token_hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (recovery_id) DO UPDATE SET account_id = excluded.account_id, rgen = excluded.rgen, started = excluded.started, release_at = excluded.release_at, state = excluded.state, source = excluded.source, token_hash = excluded.token_hash
